about.subtitle: Local-first desktop time tracking.
about.builtDesktopText: No cloud, no tracking, no subscriptions. Just a local-first desktop app to track your time and export it to Excel.
about.localFirstText: SQLite storage with a repository boundary for future sync adapters.
about.exportsText: Excel workbooks generated locally using ExcelJS.
about.storyText: Timesheet Parrot was created by a freelancer who wanted a simple, local-first simple desktop app to track time and export it to Excel. The existing options were cloud based or lacked this basic feature once they went to freemium model. The parrot mascot signifies the motive of the app to mimic this most important feature from the paid apps
about.contributeText: Timesheet Parrot is open source and welcomes contributions. If you are a developer, designer, tester or translator, please check out the GitHub repository and submit a pull request or issue. If you like the project, please ⭐ the repository to show your support.
